name: garmin-claude-mcp

scripts.test: esbuild test/diet.test.ts test/integration.test.ts test/routes.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --alias:cloudflare:workers=./test/cloudflare-workers-shim.mjs --out-extension:.js=.mjs --outdir=.test-out --log-level=warning && node --test .test-out/diet.test.mjs .test-out/integration.test.mjs .test-out/routes.test.mjs && npm run check:app

description: Connect Garmin training data to Claude and push workouts back to your watch

INTERVALS_API_KEY.description: Your intervals.icu API key. Settings > Developer Settings.

INTERVALS_ATHLETE_ID.description: Your intervals.icu athlete id, the iNNNNNN in your profile URL.

MCP_PASSWORD.description: Password you will type when connecting Claude. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.description: Optional, for the coach agent. Telegram bot token from @BotFather.

TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID.description: Optional, for the coach agent. Your Telegram chat id.

ROUTINE_FIRE_URL.description: Optional, for the coach agent. Fire URL of the Claude Code scheduled task's API trigger.

ROUTINE_FIRE_TOKEN.description: Optional, for the coach agent. Token of that API trigger.

GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Optional, for the dietitian. Free key from aistudio.google.com (Get API key).
